candidates.researchQuestion: 智能体委派工作后，资源消耗应由实际执行者还是授权工作的根目标承担预算责任？
candidates.title: Delegation Budgets Belong to the Root Objective
candidates.coreProposition: Delegated resource consumption should preserve worker-level origin evidence while charging the inherited budget to the root objective that authorized the work; accurate shared-root accounting closes a demonstrated delegation escape but does not itself prove immediate cancellation, generalized quotas or exactly-once enforcement.

sections.heading: Delegation Creates Two Different Identities
sections.heading_zh: 两个身份：消耗来源与预算归属

sections.heading: Shared Root Accounting Closes the Demonstrated Escape
sections.heading_zh: 共享根账户如何关闭委派逃逸

sections.heading: Accounting Truth Is Not Execution Revocation
sections.heading_zh: 记账事实不等于执行撤销

sections.heading: What the Evidence Still Does Not Prove

evidenceClaims.claim: The merged Codex change introduces shared root accounting state and routes descendant token increments into the root accumulator.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 已合并 Codex 变更引入共享根记账状态，并把后代令牌增量路由到根累计器。

evidenceClaims.claim: The demonstrated accounting covers active and idle progress, an unloaded intermediate parent, root-goal replacement and checkpoint concurrency.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 已展示记账覆盖活跃与空闲进度、中间父执行体卸载、根目标替换和检查点并发。

evidenceClaims.claim: Combined root and descendant usage can transition the root goal to a budget-limited state, without proving synchronous cancellation of every descendant.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 根与后代合并用量可以推动根目标进入预算受限状态，但不能证明所有后代同步取消。

evidenceClaims.claim: Delegated resource governance should retain worker-level origin evidence while charging inherited use to the authorizing root objective.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 委派资源治理应保留执行体级来源证据，同时把继承消耗计入授权工作的根目标。

evidenceClaims.claim: Accurate inherited accounting does not by itself establish revocation, cancellation, generalized quotas or exactly-once enforcement.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 准确的继承记账本身不能建立撤销、取消、通用配额或恰好一次执行保证。

projectRelevance.rationale: The conclusion is a general engineering and governance pattern that remains independently valuable without a first-party project mapping.

communityEdition.rationale: The complete Research Center edition already provides the transferable engineering argument; a separate community edition would repeat the same evidence without a distinct discussion angle.

candidates.researchQuestion: 当系统明确要求最新远程权限时，缓存策略还能保留什么价值，又必须失去什么权力？
candidates.title: Cached Policy Is Evidence, Not Current Authority
candidates.title_zh: 缓存策略是证据，不是当前权限
candidates.coreProposition: When current remote authority is explicitly required, stale cached policy may remain stored evidence but must not retain authorization power; the runtime should represent unresolved freshness as an explicit restrictive authority state with named affected capabilities and recovery conditions.

sections.heading: Cached Data Can Remain While Authority Expires
sections.heading_zh: 缓存仍可保留，但权限可以失效

sections.heading: Freshness Belongs to Evidence Admission
sections.heading_zh: 新鲜性属于证据准入，而不是缓存优化

sections.heading: Undetermined Must Be a Governed Authority State
sections.heading_zh: “无法确定”应成为受治理权限状态

sections.heading: Availability Exceptions Need Explicit Authority
sections.heading_zh: 可用性例外必须显式授权

sections.heading: Implementation Questions the Release Note Leaves Open

evidenceClaims.claim: GitHub's Copilot CLI 1.0.81 changelog reports that forced remote-settings refresh rejects both the one-hour cache fast path and documented 24-hour stale fallback.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: GitHub Copilot CLI 1.0.81 变更说明报告，强制远程设置刷新会拒绝一小时缓存快速路径和文档中的二十四小时旧数据回退。

evidenceClaims.claim: The changelog reports a restrictive posture for named governed capabilities while fresh managed policy is unresolved.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 变更说明报告，在最新受管策略尚未确认时，被点名的受治理能力进入限制状态。

evidenceClaims.claim: The restrictive state lasts until fresh managed policy is successfully fetched, while the release note does not disclose validation internals.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 限制状态持续到成功取得最新受管策略，而发布说明没有披露验证内部机制。

evidenceClaims.claim: Cache validity and authority admissibility are separate properties when freshness is part of the governing predicate.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 当新鲜性属于治理条件时，缓存有效与权限证据可准入是两个不同属性。

evidenceClaims.claim: Unavailable current authority should become an explicit restrictive state rather than silently preserving last-known permissions.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 无法确认当前权威时，应进入显式限制状态，而不能静默保留最后一次已知权限。

candidates.researchQuestion: 可复用的审批证据应绑定什么身份，才能在授权撤销后立即失效，而不是只依赖时间新鲜度？
candidates.title: Approval Caches Need an Authorization Identity
candidates.title_zh: 审批缓存必须绑定授权身份
candidates.coreProposition: Reusable approval evidence should be bound to the authorization identity under which it was produced and revalidated immediately before it becomes execution authority; recency and action identity alone cannot make a cache revocation-aware, while version equality proves only the authority dimensions encoded by that version.

sections.heading: Why Recent Approval Evidence Can Still Be Stale
sections.heading_zh: 为什么“最近用过”仍可能过期

sections.heading: Bind Approval Evidence to Authorization Identity
sections.heading_zh: 把审批证据绑定到授权身份

sections.heading: Concurrent Revocation Makes Use-Time Revalidation Necessary
sections.heading_zh: 并发撤销使消费时复核成为必要

sections.heading: Version Equality Proves Only Encoded Authority Facts
sections.heading_zh: 版本相等只证明元组编码的事实

evidenceClaims.claim: The merged Codex change defines an authorization version from selected conversation and host-produced input facts, with optional root identity for worker threads.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 已合并 Codex 变更根据选定的会话与宿主输入事实定义授权版本，并为工作线程关联可选根身份。

evidenceClaims.claim: Successful cached scores record local and optional root authorization identity, and fast approval recomputes current authorization before use.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 成功缓存的分数记录本地与可选根授权身份，快速批准在使用前重新计算当前授权。

evidenceClaims.claim: Regression coverage changes authorization while classification is in flight and prevents the late low-risk result from becoming current fast-approval evidence.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 回归测试覆盖分类进行中授权发生变化，并阻止迟到的低风险结果成为当前快速批准证据。

evidenceClaims.claim: Reusable approval evidence should be keyed by the authorization identity under which it was produced and revalidated at consumption.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 可复用审批证据应以生成时的授权身份为键，并在消费时重新核验。

evidenceClaims.claim: Authorization-version equality proves continuity only for the authority inputs represented by the tuple.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 授权版本相等只证明元组实际表示的权限输入具有连续性。
